title: pipeline-tap campaign result (one JSON file per app × channel probe)

method.description: how the stack was identified (loaded modules, linked frameworks, open CDP port, process name...)

signature.description: the concrete signal, e.g. 'Qt6Core.dll loaded', 'libgtk-4.so.1 mapped', 'CDP :9222 responds'

detected_before_use.description: H5: could a router have predicted channel availability BEFORE probing?

channel_setup.description: what was needed: flags, permissions, injection method

failure_class.description: silent = channel returned a view that diverged from the screen WITHOUT declaring it (disqualifying). explicit = gaps declared (opaque rects / errors). blocked = OS policy/permissions.

t1_read_text.description: read known on-screen text through the channel; exact match?

t2_enumerate.description: interactive elements + bounding boxes vs ground truth

t3_live_value.description: typed field value visible in the channel?

t4_living_screen.description: self-updating region (clock/progress): change seen? cost per tick?

t5_blind_action.description: click at channel-derived coords; intended effect verified?

t6_pictorial.description: images/canvas regions declared with rects? targeted crop possible?

runtime_verification.description: H5.3 spot-check: does the channel view agree with a screenshot?

method.description: e.g. '5 questions answered from both, compared' or 're-render + pixel diff'

raw_artifacts.description: paths of dumps/screenshots kept as evidence
